title: A traffic head for net1 v7: training data on the fixed guest, the head, and its score on validation links
description: net1 v7's beliefs keep little of what tells copies of the flow from a stock TCP flow (balanced accuracy 0.472 per step on held-out validation links, against 0.709 from the raw measurements; exp-competitor-info-v7-299). A traffic head (src/expliccit_env/train/traffic.py) estimates that class from net1's own scaled measurements, trained against ground truth, so the information can move into net1. This gathers its training data on the fixed guest: the fixed rule on net1 v7 (u = 0.25; exp-net1v6-229, its chosen run) as the observed flow on the training links (campaign seed 1, 30 s) under the new family's conditions and as 1, 2 and 4 copies, steps kept, the held-out competitors (BBRv3, Westwood) left out. experiments/traffic_head.py reports the head's balanced accuracy on training links held out of its fit and saves the head fitted on all of them (traffic_head.pt); experiments/traffic_head_val.py scores that head, unchanged, on run 299's validation links (val/summary.md), where the raw-measurement classifier fitted on those links reached 0.709. The next run takes a learned net2's beliefs about the other traffic from this head.
prepare: N="$IN/v7/$(cat "$IN/v7/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; test -f "$N"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule7" "$N" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-new" --split train --family new --duration-ms 30000 --seed 1 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-new/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-new"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split train --duration-ms 30000 --seed 1 --n 1 2 4 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: N="$IN/v7/$(cat "$IN/v7/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/traffic_head.py "$OUT" "$N"; mkdir -p "$OUT/val"; uv run python experiments/traffic_head_val.py "$OUT/val" "$IN/data" "$N" "$OUT/traffic_head.pt"; rm -f "$OUT/rule7/rule-u0.25-actor.pt"
